regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, top-heavy leadership picture: Banks (H + HK) lead with a modest margin over challenger Diversified Miners, but the leader is mean-reverting (hurst_tag) and ineligible miners carry high score with zero breadth. Only 4 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true), so most of the market is in a trend-unfriendly or shake-out posture; no scorable ETF proxy exists for the leading eligible themes except China Tech/Platform via 3033.HK.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Diversified Miners (rank 2, score 1.23, currently ineligible with breadth 0.0) converts to eligible=true — that would be a confirmed leadership handoff worth reassessing, since the leader Banks is mean-reverting and only 0.103 margin separates them.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the rotation with the highest durability bar (0.59) and are eligible under the trend gate, the one validated risk-control leg. The lean is a defensive tilt toward the prevailing concentration, not a return forecast — supported by rank 1, eligibility, and reasonable durability. However, hurst_tag is mean-revert and the theme is unscorable, so conviction is capped.
evidence: durability_bar 0.59 is highest among top themes
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst tag suggests the leadership is not trending; high score with modest breadth (0.538) and a thin margin over miners means the bank narrative could roll over quickly without a trend impulse behind it.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) lose the rank-1 slot to Diversified Miners before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: The only scorable theme in the set is deeply negative momentum (rank 13, score -0.635, eligible=false) and below benchmark on the trend gate. This is a clear stay-away until the trend gate turns it eligible. Avoid is a direction, not a short.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag could mean it is due to snap back; an unscheduled macro headline (share 0.4) could ignite a sharp tech relief rally that the gate is too slow to catch.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet (3033.HK) moves back above its absolute-trend eligibility line before the 30-day check-by date.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: Worst-ranked theme in the set (rank 15, score -1.255, eligible=false), sharing the same scorable proxy 3033.HK as China Tech. Its near-zero durability bar and extreme negative crowding_z (-0.74) flag heavy de-risking, but crowding is a size-down caution only — the lean here is simply to not allocate given the absolute-trend gate failure.
theses.dissent: Extreme negative crowding could signal capitulation and a sharp reversal, but the detector has no validated forward edge on rotation timing, so this is not tradeable information.

falsifier.text: China Platform Megacaps (3033.HK) regains absolute-trend eligibility before the 30-day check-by date.
